welcome.title: Welcome To QuizLoop
welcome.lead: Four short notes, then you can start.
welcome.module.title: What Is A Module?
welcome.module.body: A module is a package that carries the questions of one subject. QuizLoop has no questions of its own; modules bring them. Two sample modules come installed: one explains the app, the other asks general knowledge.
welcome.add.title: How Do You Add Your Own Module?
welcome.add.body: A module is a single file ending in .qlmod; you get it from whoever prepared it. In the Library press "Add a module file" and point at the file. Dropping the file on the window or double-clicking it does the same.
welcome.add.bodyPackage: A module is a single file ending in .qlmod; you get it from whoever prepared it. Download it to your phone, press "Add a module file" in the Library and pick the file.
welcome.study.title: How Do You Study?
welcome.study.body: Press "Start session" on a module. Answer the question, read the solution, then mark how well you understood. A question you did not understand returns in the same session, a partly understood one returns soon; an understood one retires. A retired question is never asked again; the percentage on a card is the share you have retired.
welcome.data.title: Your Data Stays With You
welcome.data.body: There is no account. Your progress is kept on this device only.
welcome.again: You can reopen this introduction from the About section in Settings.
goals.title: Goals
goals.subtitle: Set and follow a daily goal for each module here.
goals.none: This module has no goal. Pick one of the six periods below.
goals.empty: No module is installed. Add one from the Library tab first.
goals.pick: Choose how long you give yourself to finish the module; the daily goal follows from it.
goals.info.1: Six periods sit under each module: 1 Week, 3 Weeks, 1 Month, 3 Months, 1 Year, 3 Years. Each button shows how many questions a day that period means; press to choose it, press the chosen one again to remove the goal.
goals.info.2: The daily goal is worked out for you: the questions remaining divided by the days remaining.
goals.info.3: What counts is a retired question: one you marked as understood and will not be asked again. Answering alone does not move the goal.
goals.info.4: Skip a day and the goal stays; the shortfall is spread over the following days and the daily number rises a little.
goals.info.5: A goal does not change how many questions a session holds and it stays on this device. You can change the period or remove the goal at any time.
goals.notifyAsk: Shall we remind you once at 19:00 when the goal is not done? Permission is asked only when you press this button.
goals.notifyOn: Reminder is on: a notification arrives at 19:00 when the goal is not done.
goals.notifyNone: Notifications are not supported on this device yet.
goals.notifyDenied: Permission was not given. Allow notifications for QuizLoop in the system or browser settings.
goals.notifyNext: Today's goal is {daily} questions. If it is not done yet, now is a good time.
